name: Amazon Data Services India - Kandukur/Meerkhanpet (Hyderabad Pharma City) campus
developer: Amazon Data Services India Pvt Ltd (AWS)
notes: EC granted Feb 2020 (SIA/TG/MIS/136947/2020) for Data Center at Plot 1, Sy 120, Pharma City, Meerkhanpet (V), Kandukur (M), Ranga Reddy; EC amendment sought 2025-26 (site area/built-up changes). Now the 48-acre anchor of Amazon's Rs 60,000 crore Telangana commitment (foundation stone ceremony at Bharat Future City 15 Jul 2026). IT load MW not published in public EC summary.

name: Amazon Data Services India - Chandanvelly/Hythabad (Shabad mandal) campus
developer: Amazon Data Services India Pvt Ltd (AWS)
notes: EC/EMP on PARIVESH-adjacent EC portal for Data Center at Sy 190(P) Chandanvelly + 195(P) Hythabad, Shabad mandal, Ranga Reddy (file SIA/TG/INFRA2/503345/2024); ~33 acres, Rs 5,821 crore, phased; Telangana allocated 98 acres in Chandanvelly to Amazon (Jan 2025). One of two $1.6B AWS campuses; part of AWS ap-south-2 Hyderabad region build-out. Included among ECs questioned by Scientists for People (May 2026).

name: AWS Bharat Future City hyperscale data centre
notes: Foundation stone laid by CM 15 Jul 2026 at Bharat Future City, Ranga Reddy district; flagship of AWS's Rs 60,000 crore (~USD 7 billion over 14 years, MoU Dec 2025) Telangana expansion. 202 acres allocated to Amazon in Bharat Future City. Capacity not yet published; construction just commenced.

name: Microsoft India South Central region Hyderabad campuses (Chandanvelly, Mekaguda, Shadnagar/Ellikatta, Kottur)
notes: Azure India South Central region live Aug 2026 (Microsoft's 4th India region). Land acquired 2022: 22 ac Mekaguda, 41 ac Shadnagar, 52 ac Chandanvelly (all Ranga Reddy district); 3 more DCs announced 2023 (total 6). Mekaguda campus construction targeted completion 2025 w/ ~180 staff. IT load MW not published; physical campuses all in Ranga Reddy district.

name: CtrlS Hyderabad (Financial District Rated-4 + DC3 AI-ready + FAB City land)
notes: Official page: Rated-4 Hyderabad data center, 13 MW IT load (Financial District, Serilingampally, Ranga Reddy). CtrlS launched 13MW/1,300-rack AI-ready DC3 (2025, AIM) and acquired ~40 acres at Chandanvelly (Shabad mandal, Ranga Reddy) for further hyperscale DC. Capacity 13 = current IT load; campus expansion capacity not separately published.

name: Nxtra by Airtel Hyderabad hyperscale data center (Kokapet)
notes: Official Nxtra hyperscale facility page for Hyderabad (Kokapet, Rajendranagar mandal, Ranga Reddy). Operational hyperscale DC; capacity not published on page (Airtel annual report would give MW).

name: STT GDC India Hyderabad 1 (Kondapur, Serilingampally)
notes: STT Hyderabad 1 listed on official STT GDC India site; EPI cert shows Hyderabad DC1 (VSB) TIA-942 Rated-3, address Property No 1-55/10, Sy 185, Serilingampally, Kondapur, Rangareddy, Telangana (cert valid to 2027).

name: STT GDC India new AI-ready data centre campus (Telangana MoU)
notes: MoU with Govt of Telangana (Jan 2025) for Rs 3,500 crore AI-ready campus near Hyderabad with ~100 MW targeted capacity. MoU-stage: land/approvals not yet public; campus district within Hyderabad metro unconfirmed (likely Rangareddy).

name: Sify Technologies Hyderabad campus (FAB City, Maheshwaram)
notes: Sify operates Hyderabad DCs incl. Financial District facility (Serilingampally, Rangareddy) and FAB City (Maheshwaram, Rangareddy) campus; aggregator lists FAB City campus designed for up to 250+ MW IT capacity (planned full build-out, not current). 250 MW stored as planned full-buildout; operational MW per official site not published.

name: AdaniConneX Hyderabad campus (Elkatta, Pargi Road)
notes: Aggregator-listed 100 MW campus at Pargi Road/Elkatta (Rangareddy, near Shadnagar); Hyderabad site first India DC to get British Safety Council 5-star grading (Mar 2025) - indicates operational facility. 100 MW is planned campus capacity (aggregator); official AdaniConneX capacity statement needed for A-grade.

name: Pi DATACENTERS Hyderabad (Financial District)
notes: Tier III design-compliant facility in Hyderabad Financial District (Serilingampally/Rangareddy), 3 MW power with expandable capacity per aggregator. C-grade until official Pi page/filings verified.

name: Telangana Data Centre City (Aloor village, Chevella mandal, ~1,500 acres)
notes: India's first dedicated data centre city proposed on ~1,500 acres at Aloor village, Chevella mandal (Ranga Reddy district); DPR being prepared per CM direction (Jun 2026). Chevella mandal is within Rangareddy district. Policy-stage project: no named investors/sites yet.

name: UPC Volt 100 MW AI-ready data centre (Bharat Future City)
developer: UPC Volt (UPC Renewables Group + VOLT Data Centers JV)
notes: MoU signed at WEF Davos (Jan 2026): 100 MW AI-ready data centre at Bharat Future City (Ranga Reddy) + dedicated 100 MW renewable facility, Rs 5,000 crore over 5 years. MoU-stage lead; Bharat Future City is in Ranga Reddy district.
